issue: TUHS 官网逐字“Browse the old Unix source code via a web interface at the Unix Tree.”——源码树经网页界面开放浏览、复原面直接呈现版本流变成立。

title: 发行档的版本序列
issue: TUHS 档案目录实测“Index of /Archive/Distributions/UCB”逐版分目录——发行档逐版存列、序列即流变叙述骨架成立。

title: 重建工程的保存宗旨
issue: TUHS 官网逐字“Its aims are to preserve and maintain historical UNIX artifacts, and to provide a forum for discussion of UNIX and its history.”——保存器物与开放讨论并举的宗旨自述成立。

title: 版本差分的作业次第
issue: LWN 文逐字“It's chicken-and-egg, but you work in stages.”——复原分阶段接续、次第安排为差分作业框架成立。

title: 代码证据的文献对读
issue: 同文逐字“He researched primary sources like publications, technical reports, man pages, or names written in comments in the source code”——出版物与报告成归属线索、代码证据接入文献链成立。

title: 复原次序的作业步骤
issue: 口述史汇编页逐字“The file system on the PDP-7 was created in assembly language.”——早期系统自底层做起的步骤依赖成立。

title: 通史叙述的证据基座
issue: 同页逐字“Write programs that do one thing and do it well. Write programs to work together.”——工具哲学见诸规范文本、基座文本支撑通史层叙述成立。

title: 树状叙事的简化问题
issue: Lévénez《UNIX History》图页自述逐字“a simplified diagram of unix history”与“Note 1 : an arrow indicates an inheritance like a compatibility, it is not only a matter of source code.”——树状谱系自我承认简化（箭头混承继与兼容）成立。

title: 横向流动的遮蔽面
issue: 同页逐字“an arrow indicates an inheritance like a compatibility, it is not only a matter of source code.”（跨系流动被记作兼容箭头）＋LWN 文逐字“line-by-line attribution of each author's contributions”（逐提交考据为展开方法）——横向流动呈网状、遮蔽面须逐提交考据双源成立。

title: 替代模型的未竟状态
issue: Lévénez 图页实测（末次更新 2026-01-27）与 Spinellis《A Tale of Four Kernels》作者页实测（ICSE '08，May 2008，页 381–390，图含“History of the examined systems”）——网状与动态两类替代模型实物在案、未成主流为状态自述（旧树史料注“2006”系年份误植，见转呈件）。

title: 图外贡献者的史料稀缺
issue: LWN 文逐字“He haunted the newsgroups and mailing lists of old Unix hackers”、逐字“He recently discovered an author unacknowledged in the Git logs whose contributions he wants to add.”；Lévénez 图页逐字“There are numerous derivative systems not listed in this chart, maybe 10 times more!”——图外者依赖列表与口述、遗漏为常态双源成立。

title: 实现差异的因果分疏
issue: DragonFly 官网逐字“shares ancestor code with other BSD operating systems”——同源系统各自演化、实现差异为因果分疏第一手对象成立。

title: 设计决策的代码落点
issue: 同页逐字“The most prominent one is HAMMER2, our modern high performance filesystem with instant (and mount-writable) snapshots, compression, and de-duplication.”——文件系统自述设计要点、落点核对把决策叙述落到实处成立。

title: 个案解释的限度自省
issue: 同页逐字“bring up your own idea on the appropriate mailing list or IRC”——讨论入口自述社区规矩、个案解释不越出语境成立。

title: 制品时戳的复核细则
issue: kernel.org Historic 档实测“linux-0.01.tar.gz 30-Oct-1993 00:00 71K”与“linux-0.01.tar.sign 08-Aug-2013 19:15 665”两条时戳相异——存档制品带时点元数据、时戳系档面事件须纳入因果链检验的实物证据成立。
